name: llm-co-op-agent
description: Coordinate planner, coder, verifier, and reviewer roles across projects with durable handoffs and deterministic verification.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, code, verify, and review local changes.
interface.longDescription: LLM Co-op Agent is a personal Codex plugin that coordinates role-to-program assignments across projects, switches executors during a run, and preserves structured project-local handoffs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Initialize the current project with LLM Co-op, then plan, implement, verify, and review this change.
